name: Margherita Pizza
description: Classic Neapolitan pizza with San Marzano tomatoes, fresh mozzarella di bufala, and fragrant basil. Fired in a wood-burning oven at 485°C for the signature leopard-spotted crust.

name: Wagyu Smash Burger
description: Double A5 Wagyu beef patties smashed to crispy-edged perfection, stacked with aged cheddar, caramelised onions, and a house aioli on a brioche bun.

name: Neapolitan Pizza
description: Bianca base with mixed wild mushrooms, black truffle cream, taleggio, and a finish of fresh black truffle shavings and chive oil.

name: Classic Poutine
description: The Quebec classic: hand-cut fries, rich brown gravy, and squeaky cheese curds.

name: Gourmet Deli Sandwich
description: Toasted hoagie roll with smoked pulled brisket, aged provolone, and pickled red onions.

name: Poulet Pizza
description: Delicious roasted chicken pizza with a rich creamy garlic sauce base, topped with fresh herbs and mozzarella.
